basic_info.description: Modern 1BR + Den, 1BA condo located just steps from Bayview Park and the T-Third light rail. This courtyard-level home offers incredible value with an expansive exclusive-use patio, high ceilings, refinished hardwood floors, and tall windows that fill the space with natural light. The open floor plan features a chef's kitchen with ample storage and stainless steel appliances, plus a spacious bedroom with a large closet and new berber carpet. The updated bath includes a sleek standing shower, single vanity, and in-unit washer/dryer. Includes 1-car garage parking with shared EV charger. The dog-friendly, secure building is impeccably maintained and ideally located near 101/280 for an easy commute. Enjoy local favorites like Craftsman & Wolves, Gratta Wines, Laughing Monk Brewing, Frank Grizzly's, and Flora Grubb. Mi Rancho Supermarket is conveniently in the building. Across the street, Bayview Park and MLK Pool offer some of the best outdoor recreation in the city.
